full_details: You were up in the dark. The third act opens in the street, at the hot end of the day. You wrote that for now these hot days, the mad blood is stirring. On that leaf you still did not know the how. Later in the morning you knew. The wound is under the boy's own arm, the boy coming between with the best of meanings, and it is hardly a wound. You gave the dying man eight lines more and took them back in one stroke. The curse, in this first setting-down, is the short one. You thought once of Kit, and put the thought away, and you did not write the name. You did not blot the page apart from that stroke. Standing, with the pen still in your hand, you said that in July they jest first and then somebody is out, and you had not known it would be him, and that Phillips will never forgive you. Best part in it, and dead by three o'clock. You did not tell him. At two you played Two Gentlemen. At the reckoning the share was one-and-thirty shillings. You wrote it, and you did not open the coffer. It still stands at twenty pound fifteen.
one_sentence: You found how the friend dies, struck eight lines you had given him, and wrote one-and-thirty.
title: Found how the friend dies and struck eight lines
